messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 detected — multiple containers reporting OOMs + CUDA failures on inference fleet in us-west-2. Pattern: paged-attn allocator shows rising resident pages + KV cache fragmentation. auto-escalation: oncall paged-allocator.
chao: ack — I'm on it. which nodes? seeing container restarts on gpu-32-0, gpu-40-1, gpu-40-3.
sara: noticed retries and increased 5xx from customers -> metric spike in tail latency around 11:03. customer-impact: a few realtime customers saw 10-30% request errors, batch jobs retried.
mike: logs from gpu-40-1 show repeated CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS followed by OOM killer for inference-worker:
```
E CudaRuntime: cudaMemcpy failed: illegal address
E allocator: attempted alloc 512MiB, resident before alloc 79% physical
W container: killing process 14231: OOM
```
jules: also seeing paged-attn slab fragmentation metric steadily increasing for last 48h, small increments. suspect slow allocator shadow allocations leaking KV slot refs.
chao: temporary mitigation plan:
  1) reduce model concurrency on affected pools to 50% (scale down requests)
  2) disable paging for large-seq models on those nodes (force in-RAM KV eviction policy)
  3) trigger controlled container restarts on gpu-40-1 and gpu-40-3 (rolling, one at a time)
  4) enable aggressive KV eviction config: `kv.eviction.threshold=0.65` and `kv.eviction.step=0.1`
eve-support: notif sent to customers A123, B987, and internal account owners — noted degraded latency and retries, working on mitigation.
sara: can we add a short-term routing fallback to smaller quantized model variant to reduce memory pressure? any perf/regressions risk?
mike: yes — route 20% traffic to model-x-q4h (compatible). should cut per-token memory and lower resident footprint, safe for immediate fallback.
chao: executing step 1 and 3 now. starting restart on gpu-40-1. will watch OOM events and node flaps in the next 10m.
jules: capturing heap maps and allocator stats before restart — dumping `/var/log/paged-allocator/dump-$(date +%s).json` and uploading to incident artefacts.
chao: restart complete on gpu-40-1, container came back clean. observed immediate drop in resident %, KV fragment rate still climbing slowly.
chao: applied `kv.eviction.threshold=0.65` on pool `inference-pool-2`.
sara: customer comms update: A123 (prod) still seeing intermittent failures — they asked for ETA. recommend 30-45m for stabilization after rolling restarts + routing fallback.
eve-support: updated status page with "degraded latency" and message that engineers are mitigating; internal ticket LINK-INC-613333 created.
mike: captured core from gpu-40-3 before restart — sending to eng-runtime for deeper analysis. suspected root: leaked KV refs in paged-attn refcount path when attention pages are paged out and reloaded.
jules: suggested longer-term action: add additional guard to allocator to detect and reclaim orphaned KV slots every N seconds, and a metrics alert for sustained fragment growth >12h.
chao: handing off to night oncall (sara) at 20:00 PT — I will put notes in the ticket: mitigations applied, traffic diverted 20% to q4h model, `kv.eviction.threshold` lowered, two nodes restarted, artifacts uploaded.
sara: ack takeover. will watch fragment curve and customer error rates. if error rate >5% after 30m escalate to eng-runtime and SRE for cluster-level compaction.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, partial recovery observed. next update in 30m or on escalation. incident record: LINK-INC-613333-RECOVERY"
